critical.issue: Rate-limit key is 'request.client.host:phone' but behind Kubernetes ingress request.client.host is the internal proxy pod IP (observed 10.79.139.4 and 10.79.139.6 alternating). Same real user hitting different backend replicas ends up in separate counters, so 5-attempt lockout may never trigger for the real client. Should honor X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP (leftmost public IP) or fall back to phone-only bucketing. This originally masked the user's reported lockout bug during automated tests too.

minor.issue: Endpoint accepts only q= and action= filters; user_id filter silently ignored — test now uses fallback listing. Consider supporting explicit user_id/actor_id filter.
Cleanup call returned 405 for some admin ids (possibly wrong route). Superadmin still able to delete admins via UI/other flows, but the REST DELETE method here may not be wired.

action_items: Backend: fix rate-limit identifier to use trusted forwarded-for header (or phone-only) so lockout is consistent behind ingress.
Backend: DELETE /api/users/{id} returned 405 in one cleanup call — verify the route method is registered (POST vs DELETE)

Backend: pytest.ini enforces '-n 2 --dist loadscope' but test_pinjamku_flow.py stores state in a module-level STATE dict shared across classes; loadscope pins the module to one worker but not across modules. Runs are only reliably green with '-n 0'. Either mark this file @pytest.mark.serial + serialize, or refactor to fixture-based state.
Consider clearing login_attempts in a pytest session autouse fixture to avoid cross-file interference through the shared preview backend.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_routes.py _check_lock: identifier composed from request.client.host is unsafe behind proxy; move to a helper that reads X-Forwarded-For with configured trusted proxies.
test_iter8_password_change.py originally used asyncio.get_event_loop() which is deprecated & fails after another test closes the loop — replaced with a local new_event_loop helper.
Regression tests share global mutable STATE dict and require strict ordering; brittle under xdist. Recommend converting to fixtures scoped to session.

rca of the issue: Original user bug: password change did not persist. Verified fix now works: TestChangePasswordFlow all pass, PASSWORD_CHANGED audit entry present, login_attempts cleared on change, same-password rejected 400, forced re-login. Environmental gap discovered: 5-attempt lockout uses request.client.host which returns proxy pod IP behind ingress; can split counters and never trigger 429 for a real user hitting different pods. In production this only bites if load balancer distributes login attempts across replicas — recommend switching to phone-only or trusted X-Forwarded-For key.
